name: Shooting Gallery
narrator_line: Behind the far counter, mannequins in staff polos turn their heads all at once, with a sound like a dropped tray of silverware.
read_aloud: Behind the far counter, mannequins in staff polos turn their heads all at once, with a sound like a dropped tray of silverware. Each one raises a pink plastic bow that is very clearly not a toy. Somewhere above, Proctor Bell suggests getting behind things.

positions.name: Counters and sandbags (half cover); the brick prize booth (three-quarters cover).

map.layout: A carnival shooting gallery scaled up to a big room: plywood cutouts on squeaking conveyors, overturned counters, sandbags, a cash register on a stool, and mannequins in staff polos behind the far counter.
map.cover: Counters and sandbags (half cover); the brick prize booth (three-quarters cover).
map.hazards: Conveyors carry a standing Crawler 10 ft at the end of each round (00-overview.md section 5.5).

loot.gm_note: The raffle ticket does nothing. The System never explains it and it never pays out.

npcs.name: Proctor Bell
npcs.line: Cover. Get behind things. Things are your friends. People are not your friends.

voice_lines.intro: Behind the far counter, mannequins in staff polos turn their heads all at once, with a sound like a dropped tray of silverware.
voice_lines.twist: Someone steps onto a conveyor and glides ten feet sideways like a carnival prize. The mannequins keep smiling. It's in their contract.
voice_lines.win: The last mannequin drops its bow and keeps smiling anyway.

nameplate: Mannequin Staff. Level 1. "Smiling through it. Contractually."

popups.text: Half cover: +2 AC and Dex saves. Three-quarters: +5. Total: they can't target you at all. Hide behind things. Things love you. People don't.
